pli-tv-pvr2.9:1.1: Yaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena kāyasaṃsaggaṃ sādiyanapaccayā pārājikaṃ kattha paññattaṃ?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:2.1: Yaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena kāyasaṃsaggaṃ sādiyanapaccayā pārājikaṃ kattha paññattanti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:2.6: Sundarīnandā bhikkhunī avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa kāyasaṃsaggaṃ sādiyi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:2.26: kāyato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhāti, na vācato…pe…
pli-tv-pvr2.9:6.6: Thullanandā bhikkhunī jānaṃ pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpannaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nevattanā paṭicodesi na gaṇassa ārocesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:7.1: Yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā pārājikaṃ kattha paññattanti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:7.6: Thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṃghena ukkhittaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ anuvatti, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:8.1: Aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūraṇapaccayā pārājikaṃ kattha paññattanti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:8.6: Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūresuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:9.1: Yaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ussayavādikāya bhikkhuniyā aḍḍaṃ karaṇapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññatto?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:10.1: Yaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ussayavādikāya bhikkhuniyā aḍḍaṃ karaṇapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññattoti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:10.6: Thullanandā bhikkhunī ussayavādikā vihari, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:10.26: siyā kāyato ca vācato ca samuṭṭhāti, na cittato;
pli-tv-pvr2.9:10.27: siyā kāyato ca vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhāti…pe…
pli-tv-pvr2.9:14.6: Thullanandā bhikkhunī coriṃ vuṭṭhāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:14.9: siyā vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhāti, na kāyato;
pli-tv-pvr2.9:14.10: siyā kāyato ca vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhāti…pe… . (2)
pli-tv-pvr2.9:15.1: Ekā gāmantaraṃ gamanapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññattoti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:15.6: Aññatarā bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gacchi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:16.1: Samaggena saṃghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṃghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāraṇapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññattoti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:16.6: Thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṃghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṃghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāresi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:17.1: Avassutāya bhikkhuniyā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthato khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā bhuñjanapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññattoti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:17.6: Sundarīnandā bhikkhunī avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthato āmisaṃ paṭiggahesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:18.1: “Kiṃ te, ayye, eso purisapuggalo karissati avassuto vā anavassuto vā, yato tvaṃ anavassutā. Iṅgha, ayye, yaṃ te eso purisapuggalo deti khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā taṃ tvaṃ sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khāda vā bhuñja vā”ti uyyojanapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññattoti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:18.6: Aññatarā bhikkhunī— “kiṃ te, ayye, eso purisapuggalo karissati avassuto vā anavassuto vā, yato tvaṃ anavassutā. Iṅgha, ayye, yaṃ te eso purisapuggalo deti khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā taṃ tvaṃ sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khāda vā bhuñja vā”ti uyyojesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:19.1: Kupitāya anattamanāya bhikkhuniyā yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññattoti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:19.6: Caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca— “buddhaṃ paccācikkhāmi, dhammaṃ paccācikkhāmi, saṃghaṃ paccācikkhāmi, sikkhaṃ paccācikkhāmī”ti, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:20.1: Kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatāya bhikkhuniyā yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññattoti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:20.6: Caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca— “chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo, dosagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo, mohagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo, bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo”ti, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:21.1: Saṃsaṭṭhānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññattoti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:21.6: Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo saṃsaṭṭhā vihariṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:22.1: “Saṃsaṭṭhāva, ayye, tumhe viharatha. Mā tumhe nānā viharitthā”ti uyyojentiyā yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā saṃghādiseso kattha paññattoti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:22.6: Thullanandā bhikkhunī— “saṃsaṭṭhāva, ayye, tumhe viharatha. Mā tumhe nānā viharitthā”ti uyyojesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
pli-tv-pvr2.9:23.1: Dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanapaccayā pāṭidesanīyaṃ kattha paññattanti?
pli-tv-pvr2.9:23.6: Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
